_about: READ-ONLY truth for the strands-minecraft body (StrandsBot) on web + iOS (+Android). Written by LANE MINECRAFT-BODY 2026-09-22 07:0xZ from LIVE captures of the running bot (docker strands-bot, strands-minecraft main ec728be+, routes in src/web.ts + src/web/tiny.ts). Every `cases.*.body` below is a real response except telemetryDisconnected/healthDisconnected (shapeTelemetry's null rules — capturing it would mean kicking the bot) and tunnelDown (the real Cloudflare 530 of the moment). Consumers: lib/devices/minecraft.ts (web decoders, vitest), ios/Tiny/Sources/MinecraftCore.swift (MinecraftCoreTests), later Android MinecraftCore.kt.

body.title: Strands the miner
body.role: A Minecraft bot that is a real agent — perceives, acts, remembers, survives being kicked; you talk, it fells the spruce.
body.note: BodyManager.pick: kind endpoint + https url + (platform == strands-minecraft OR capabilities contain body:strands-the-miner OR minecraft). tiny-tech's enroll writes body:<fleet slug> first (registry.ts bodyCapabilities) and platform = 'strands-minecraft'; the body rides in capabilities, never in kind.

rateLimit.rule: 5 writes (POST) per second per token; reads never limited

auth.secret: env TINY_TOKEN (≥32 chars, openssl rand -hex 32) in the compose .env; the tiny device row's `secret` holds the same value; iOS reads it via GET /api/devices/<id>/credential or the owner pastes it.
auth.source: src/web/tiny.ts tinyToken/presentedToken/tokenMatches/createRateLimiter; src/web.ts guarded section (`const presented = presentedToken(req.headers, url)`); src/web/auth.ts:110 authBypassed (loopback dev bypass never applies through the tunnel or from the docker bridge)

snapshot.note: one JPEG 960×540 q60 from the SAME headless page capture_view uses; a fresh MJPEG-loop frame (<1.5 s) is served as-is; while Chrome launches (>8 s) the WARMING placeholder JPEG with X-Camera: warming — never a 404/503. Same path the worker's ENDPOINT_ACTIONS.snapshot uses.

stream.note: alias of /stream.mjpeg; ~3 fps (WEB_FRAME_MS=350); use ?token= from an

events.note: alias of /events; replays the last 100 feed events then streams; line = `data: <FeedEvent>`; FeedEvent {ts, kind: in|out|journey|thought|worker|chat|system|voice, who, text ≤2000, replyTo?}; an `out` with replyTo=<turn_id> is THE answer to that /api/chat turn

chat.reply: {ok, reply, turn_id: 'say-N', done, elapsed_s, task} — done:false = still running, follow /api/events replyTo=turn_id; ok:false + error = the turn failed
chat.note: same rail as POST /api/say (session.ask, one say id, one receipt); the relay (chatgpt-plugin-tinyai ENDPOINT_ACTIONS.chat) POSTs {prompt} and wraps the JSON as {ok:true, result}

stop.note: pathfinder.stop+setGoal(null)+clearControlStates (tools/movement.ts stop_moving), stopDigging when a dig is in flight, journeys.stop(running) — cannot abort a model turn mid-thought (Session has no abort); the note says so

say.note: unchanged browser route: 202 {ok, id}, answer only on the feed

workers.note: CREW.md contract (lane B 2026-10-04): every manage_bots worker as a BODY. ids `w-<n>` are stable for the worker's life and never re-used after a restart; state working|idle|stalled|dead (stalled = no step for 3 min); camera.frames/watchers additive.

workerTelemetry.source: src/web.ts → shapeTelemetry of the WORKER's bot + `worker` row
workerTelemetry.note: same shape as /api/telemetry (task.kind='fleet', crew=[]); 404 {ok:false,error:'no worker <id>'} once pruned

workerSnapshot.note: the worker's OWN prismarine-viewer (next free port above VIEWER_PORT) rendered in a page of the SAME headless Chrome; never 404 while alive (dead → 200 placeholder, `X-Camera: broken: worker <status> - no body`); near-field: workers load viewDistance 3

workerStream.note: ~3 fps, frames only while a watcher is attached; 410 once the worker is dead. NOT proxied by the tiny worker (infinite body) — web polls the snapshot.

workerStop.note: reflex-level: pathfinder, controls, dig of ONE worker; no model turn; the worker keeps its task and gets a 🛑 inbox note

workerHire.note: = manage_bots hire → 201 {ok, worker:row}; 400 goal required; 409 live duplicate name

workerRetire.note: = manage_bots dismiss → 200 {ok, worker:row(state dead)}; 404 unknown id

crewPager.pages: page 0 = the bot (today's card); pages 1..n = GET /api/workers rows in order
crewPager.poll: GET /api/workers every 2 s while the card is open; thumbnails via /api/workers/{id}/camera/snapshot at 1 fps on the VISIBLE page only; MJPEG only when expanded (iOS/Android)
crewPager.stop: per page: page 0 → POST /api/stop, page n → POST /api/workers/{id}/stop
crewPager.hire: chip → POST /api/workers {goal} (one text field); greyed at health.workers.alive >= max
crewPager.deadPage: a page whose row turned dead stays until the next poll drops it; the pager clamps to the last page
